2. King. 1. 17.
2. King. 3. 1.
Ahaziah died, and Iehoram raigned in his stead [in the second yeere of Iehoram the son of Iehosaphat] King of Iudah.
Ichoram the sonne of Ahab raigned in the [eighteenth yeere of Iehosaphat. Chap. 8. 16. In the [fift yere of Ioram the sonne of Ahab] Iehoram the sonne of Iehoshaphat began to raigne, and raigned eight yeeres.
